items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: and the bass trombone player, Chuck Connors, Duke had written a part for him

ctx.x: You said Duke always thought in terms of sound effects, or total sound, and didn't think in notes.

Yeah, I think he was an effect man, and that's what attracted me to them quite a bit, because everybody else, when I was coming up, thought in terms of notes, but Duke had effects. There was one time he had a funny line. He'd -- you know, horns have different ranges, and the bass trombone player, Chuck Connors, Duke had written a part for him and he kept going down, down, down, to the bottom register of his horn, and Chuck says, "Duke these other notes that you've got here are down below and they're off the…
